name: Basil
description: Lush, tender green leaves with a sweet, pungent scent that epitomizes the warmth of summer gardens and kitchens.

img.alt: An illustration of a bushy basil plant with broad green leaves in a terracotta pot
img.caption: Small flowers, plenty of character.

grow: Find a warm, sheltered spot receiving ample daily sunshine.
Keep soil consistently moist, rich, and well-drained.
Protect young plants from chilly drafts and frost.
Pinch out growing tips regularly to encourage a bushy shape.
enjoy: Harvest fresh leaves for tomatoes, pesto and anything summery.
Enjoy the rich fragrance as you brush past pots on a patio.
Add fresh torn leaves to salads, pasta dishes, and homemade sauces.
Pinch off flower buds early to maximize leaf production.
